units.source_text: 源氏公子几度举袖掩面，安慰他道：

en.t: Prince Genji raised his sleeve several times to cover his face, and comforted him, saying:
Whether one lives long or dies young is uncertain; the length of life is never fixed.

units.source_text: 固知此乃人世之常态，但躬逢其事，痛苦实不堪言！

en.t: I know well that this is the ordinary condition of human life, yet when one meets it personally, the pain is truly beyond words.

units.source_text: 小婿自当将此情状向父皇奏闻，定能深蒙鉴察。”

en.t: I shall report these circumstances to my imperial father, and I am sure he will understand them deeply.
The Minister of the Left then urged him:
The long rain keeps falling, and I fear there may be no time when it stops.

units.source_text: 吾婿不如乘天色未黑之时，早早动身。”

en.t: My son-in-law had better set out early, while the sky has not yet grown dark.
